thread:
Sam: Heads-up  sales pushed a batch of retro credits labeled 'q2-expt' into Zuora this morning. Total ~ $145k across ~30 customers. Holding for month-end.

Nina: Clarify: are these credits for past invoiced usage or future service?

Sam: Sales confirmed past usage (Apr/May)  it's a post-hoc pricing experiment refund.

Carlos: Accounting viewpoint: if this reduces previously recognized revenue and is material to the product/period, we need a prior-period adjustment. If immaterial, we book a current-period catch-up (contra-revenue).

Maya: Our policy: restate threshold = 5% of product period revenue or $250k absolute. Also need invoice->revenue-schedule mapping for RCS adjustments.

BillingBot: billing_event: batch=2026-06-17-q2expt, credit_memos=30, total_credit=145000.00, label="q2-expt"

Sam: Ops action: 1) place manual holds on these credit memos so NetSuite/RCS doesn't auto-reverse; 2) extract invoice->schedule ids; 3) compute product-level impact; 4) decide restate vs catch-up.

Nina: I'll get the mapping and run the product% calc. ETA 45m.

Carlos: If catch-up journal (example):

```
DR Sales Returns & Allowances  X
  CR Accounts Receivable      X
DR Revenue Adjustment (contra) X
  CR Revenue                  X
```

Carlos: If deferred promo (not the case here given sales note), we'd move to deferred liability and amortize.

BillingBot: hold_applied: memo_ids=[57001,57002,57015], set_by=Sam, ts=2026-06-17T09:20:15Z

Nina: Calc done: Product Alpha Q2 revenue = $1,800,000; credits impacting Alpha = $120,000 => 6.67% -> exceeds 5% threshold.

Maya: That suggests a prior-period adjustment for Product Alpha. Accounting ops to prepare restatement workbook (per-account GL impact, RCS schedule diffs). Reporting/FP&A to draft disclosure.

Sam: I'll notify Sales ops to stop similar promos until we have an intake/approval form. Also tagging Audit once Maya uploads the pack.

Carlos: Next steps: Maya to upload restatement pack to /finance/month-end/restatements; Sam to create sign-off matrix; Nina to provide per-invoice mappings. We'll pause posting until approvals.

Maya: On it. ETA EOD for the workbook and sign-off checklist.

Sam: Thanks team. Closing the loop here ":thumbsup:"
